INSTRUCTIONS: Copy this file, rename it, edit the targets array.
Reference in a run file as: targets/<folder>/my_<name>
Each target needs: behavior, speed_kmh, start_pos, altitude_m.
Extra fields depend on behavior (see PARAM_DOCS).

PARAM_DOCS.behavior: crossing+s_maneuver  — Boeing demo scenario. 5 targets at same altitude create multiple swap opportunities.
PARAM_DOCS.speed_kmh: Target speed in km/h. 200-2000 for aircraft, 20-60 for ships.
PARAM_DOCS.start_pos: [x, y, z] NED meters. z is negative (altitude above ground).
PARAM_DOCS.altitude_m: Altitude ASL in meters. Overrides start_pos(3).
